general.language_hint: [de] Explicitly override CRABS display language or sync automatically with the game.
general.check_updates_hint: [de] Periodically check for CRABS updates, and notify me.
general.perf_mode_hint: [de] Applies performance optimizations to the base game.
general.banner_hint: [de] Display info banner on room join.
general.privacy_full_hint: [de] If enabled, the Privacy Mode hotkey blanks the entire screen instead of just the left side.
general.halo_hint: [de] Show a pulsing halo effect on character avatars when you mouse over them in the roster or chat.
general.edit_keybinds_hint: [de] Open the game's Keybindings menu to change the Privacy Mode and Drawer hotkeys.

drawer.enable_hint: [de] Enable the sliding drawer interface on the edge of the screen.
drawer.tab_hint: [de] Display the CRABS drawer tab on the edge of the screen.
drawer.animated_logo_hint: [de] Use the animated logo when performance is optimal.
drawer.close_whisper_hint: [de] Close drawer after sending a whisper+ message.
drawer.close_chat_hint: [de] Close drawer after sending a message.
drawer.focus_hover_hint: [de] When you mouse over a player's card, change the page they are on.
drawer.auto_scroll_hint: [de] Automatically scroll the drawer roster to the character matching the avatar your mouse is over.

maps.compass_hint: [de] Show a directional arrow on map.

chat.mentions_hint: [de] Highlights chat messages containing your name or nickname.
chat.notifications_hint: [de] Get an OS alert when mentioned (only triggers if the game is tabbed out or minimized).
chat.caps_hint: [de] Forces the first letter of your name(s) to be capitalized when highlighted.
chat.color_match_hint: [de] Colors your name in highlighted messages to match your character's actual label color.
chat.custom_words_hint: [de] Comma-separated list of extra words to trigger highlights.
chat.ignore_phrases_hint: [de] One phrase per line. Use * as a wildcard (e.g., 'pick* a rose').
chat.highlight_color_hint: [de] Pick a custom color for chat highlights.
chat.hover_links_hint: [de] Mousing over names in the chat log triggers the roster focus halo and map compass.
chat.auto_beep_hint: [de] Attempt to send Whisper+ as a beep if a friend leaves the room before you hit send.
chat.normalize_font_hint: [de] Temporarily converts fancy/styled Unicode fonts in chat messages to standard text while hovering over them.

config.local_only_hint: [de] If checked, settings are only saved to this browser and will not sync across your devices.
config.cloud_hint: [de] Shows how much server allowance is used. Exceeding this will truncate new items from the server sync.
config.delete_server_hint: [de] Wipes your CRABS settings from the game server.
config.export_hint: [de] Copy your settings string to share or backup.
config.import_hint: [de] Paste a settings string to overwrite current config.

notifications.cloud_both_limit: [de] Cloud Sync: Dropped invalid long strings AND reached 8KB storage limit. Excess kept local.
notifications.cloud_capacity_limit: [de] Cloud Sync capacity reached (8KB). Excess words/phrases kept local only.
notifications.cloud_invalid_items: [de] Cloud Sync: Dropped individual words/phrases that exceeded character limits. Kept local.
notifications.export_failed: [de] Failed to copy config to clipboard.
notifications.import_prompt: [de] Paste your CRABS settings string here:
notifications.import_invalid: [de] Import failed. Invalid or corrupted string.
